samples.A: every registry validation window: the sample a registered {basin}/track_error_{lead}h_nm is a mean over
samples.B: the windows of A where every compared member has a forecast and the verifying best-track fix is at the initial time plus the lead
samples.C: B, and a tropical or subtropical cyclone (TD, TS, HU, SD, SS) at both the initial and the verifying time: NHC's status rule

basin_notes.CP: storm id CP: CPHC's forecasts, with no NHC-published per-forecast counterpart
basin_notes.EP: storm id EP: includes CPHC-issued forecasts for those storms west of 140W, which NHC's East Pacific verification leaves out

decision_rule: Fixed before any model number exists. Primary comparison: fusion against AVNI (the GFS track available at the cycle), Atlantic, 48 h track error, on samples B and C, with AVNO-6, EMXI/EMX2, OFCL and OCD5 beside it. Fusion's paired difference from AVNI (fusion minus AVNI) decides: positive with a storm-block interval that excludes zero on both samples, the ML layer subtracts value; negative and excluding zero on both, it adds value; otherwise this season does not decide. Beating AVNO-6 but not AVNI means the ML layer adds less than the interpolator's shift to the current position. AVNO is late guidance and decides nothing.

statistics.mean_error: mean over cases (metrics.track.verify, the registry's statistic)
statistics.storm_mean_error: mean of the storms' own means
statistics.ci95: storm-block bootstrap of the paired mean difference (10000 resamples, fixed seed)
statistics.dm_p_value: Diebold-Mariano on absolute error, one case per storm
statistics.too_few_storms: fewer than 8 storms: means only, no skill, beat rate, interval or p-value

members.name: OFCL
members.description: NHC/CPHC official forecast; OFCO then OFCL, whichever an initial time has first

members.name: AVNI
members.description: GFS tracker, previous run interpolated 6 h to the cycle's position: the GFS track available when the cycle runs

members.name: AVNO-6
members.description: AVNO of the run 6 h before the cycle, read at tau + 6 (the same valid times), not shifted to the storm's current position. For AVNO-6: the raw track of the GFS run a cycle's model fields come from

members.name: AVNO
members.description: raw GFS tracker of the cycle's own run, which arrives after NHC's t+3 h advisory; its wind is tracker output, not intensity guidance

members.name: EMXI/EMX2
members.description: ECMWF tracker, interpolated to the cycle's position: the 00/12Z run shifted 6 h (EMXI) at 06/18Z, the run before shifted 12 h (EMX2) at 00/12Z -- the ECMWF track available when the cycle runs; EMXI then EMX2, whichever an initial time has first

members.name: OCD5
members.description: CLIPER5 track with Decay-SHIFOR5 intensity: NHC's skill baseline

members.name: XTRP
members.description: extrapolation of the current motion from the working fixes (no intensity): persistence as an operational centre has it

members.name: persistence
members.description: the registry's baseline: the last 6 h motion and the current wind of the emulated working fixes, held (`real_run.StageWindow.persistence`)

members.name: persistence_besttrack
members.description: the same rule from the un-noised final best track: what the registry's baseline scores without the emulator's noise

members.name: fusion
members.description: registered fusion v12, from the per-case forecast file

members.name: lstm
members.description: registered lstm v12, from the per-case forecast file

members.name: cnn
members.description: registered cnn v8, from the per-case forecast file

members.name: transformer
members.description: registered transformer v8, from the per-case forecast file

members.name: gnn
members.description: registered gnn v7, from the per-case forecast file

members.name: pinn
members.description: registered pinn v7, from the per-case forecast file

AL.rules: regular advisory; tropical or subtropical at both times; every initial time; initial position inside NHC's stated domain

EP.rules: regular advisory; tropical or subtropical at both times; every initial time; initial position inside NHC's stated domain

working_fix.source: a-deck CARQ rows (tau 0: the as-issued fix of each cycle; tau -6: the history the cycle had) against the final best track

notes: A number here is comparable only with another on the same sample (A, B or C). A registered {basin}/track_error_{lead}h_nm is a mean over sample A; it must not be set beside a technique's error on B or C.

Only sample C is commensurable with the 70 nm promotion threshold, NHC's 51 nm 2026 target and NHC's published 48 h errors, which are tropical-stage numbers. C still differs from NHC's sample: the windows start 24 h after a storm's first best-track fix, and basin is the storm id's (EP rows include CPHC-issued forecasts west of 140W; CP is CPHC, with no NHC-published counterpart). `reconciliation` applies NHC's rules in full.

The inputs differ even where the cases are the same. The project's models forecast from an emulated working fix (the final best track plus noise, `working_track_noise`); OFCL, AVNI and OCD5 start from the as-issued fix (`diagnostics.working_fix`). The gridded models' GFS crops are centred on the final best-track position, so validation inputs are part noisier and part cleaner than a live cycle's.

`persistence` is the registry's baseline: linear extrapolation of the last 6 h motion of two independently perturbed fixes, with no climatology. It is not CLIPER. `persistence_besttrack` removes the noise; OCD5 is NHC's baseline. 'Beats persistence' in the registry is a lower bar than either.
OFCL is issued at t+3 h having seen the early guidance, AVNI included; the project's cycle is complete at t+1:40. AVNO at t is not available to either.
One validation season. Six-hourly cases of one storm are not independent: read n_storms and largest_storm_share with every n, and the storm-block interval before any difference.

The emulator's noise draw alone moves the registry's persistence by about 1% between two orders of drawing (335.0 against 337.9 nm, Atlantic 48 h, in the first multi-basin run): a model difference of that size is draw noise.
